body: I plan to post a response to the March CT review of A New Kind of Christianity . I just got home from a tremendous weekend in England (thanks Faithworks and church.co.uk !) and am trying to catch up on all the emails that need an immediate response, and then will try to address the CT review, which I understand is generating a lot of attention.
